<RichColor Color="1,0,0,1">PLEASE READ - IMPORTANT CHANGE COMING - MARCH 23, 2026</>

Arkitect Structures Remastered, Klinger Rustic, and Castles Keeps & Forts (CKF) will be removed on this date. Please update or rebuild prior to removal.

<RichColor Color="1,0.2,0.6,1">Welcome to Matriark!</>

This is a stable, long-term Cluster with <RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">crossplay-safe mods and plugins</> that enhance gameplay for mature players.

On Matriark you can explore, build, and survive with like-minded adults who value respect, consideration, and zero toxicity.

The founder, <RichColor Color="1,0.2,0.6,1">JustSimply_JJ</>, has been hosting Ark servers since 2021 and self-hosts Matriark solo. She actively keeps the Cluster maintained & updated.

<RichColor Color="0,0.6,1,1">Please review the rules and other helpful info before building and playing on the maps.</>

<RichColor Color="1,0.3,0.7,1">We hope you enjoy your time with us!</>

Have fun! <3

tab2.text1:
<RichColor Color="0,1,1,1">1.</> Be a respectful adult, no exceptions — no toxicity, harassment, or drama anywhere on the Cluster.

<RichColor Color="0,1,1,1">2.</> No inappropriate names or human character names (any language), final decision is JJ's.

<RichColor Color="0,1,1,1">3.</> No replacements or handouts from normal gameplay — bug-related losses may be reviewed via a help ticket only.

<RichColor Color="0,1,1,1">4.</> Repeated complaints, debates, or arguments are disruptive and not permitted.

<RichColor Color="0,1,1,1">5.</> No building close to another player or public structures.

 Base limits per tribe per map:
— 1 main base
— 1 outpost, public trap or treehouse
— 1 water pen for raising and storing water tames

<RichColor Color="0,1,1,1">6.</> Do not leave tames on breed or wander — max 2 snails + 2 dung beetles if caged & neutered.

<RichColor Color="0,1,1,1">7.</> Trading and Breeding Etiquette
— only un-mutated dinos may be traded or bred with another Tribe
— all trades must be for equal value or equivalent cost
— when applicable, use in-game shop points or resources
— no freebies that bypass player progression

<RichColor color="0,1,1,1">8.</> Do not block major resources, explorer notes, artifact caves, or public-use areas.

<RichColor Color="0,1,1,1">9.</> Max 30 tames out while offline — no tames on neutral, aggressive, or flee and all tames must be stored at your base only.

<RichColor Color="0,1,1,1">10.</> Turrets set to wilds only and medium or low range - damage is x50

<RichColor Color="0,1,1,1">11.</> Structure pickup is ON — clean up after yourself, no spamming for any reason.

<RichColor Color="0,1,1,1">12.</> Cloning chambers — max 1 per Tribe, per map

<RichColor Color="0,1,1,1">13.</> Choose Tribe members wisely, repeated rule violations may result in full tribe wipe and ban.

<RichColor Color="0,1,1,1">14.</> Help keep the maps running smoothly by turning off crafting, automation and breeding stations before extended log-off.

tab4.text1:
<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">Important Tribe Enforcer Info: </>

Tribe is auto created on join and synced across all maps. The Owner should rename the tribe then travel to all maps one time before inviting members.

<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">Awesome Teleporters:</> Act as teleporter and transmitter.

<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">SCS Cryopods:</> Tames keep their inventory in SCS cryopods, allows easy transfer of element and boss items between maps.

<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">Plugins:</> Prevent stealing and griefing; unlock storage box for player trades.

<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">The Matriark in-game shop:</> Accessed via the radial menu and offers starter kits, potions, tames, and resources. Loonies are earned by playing only.

<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">Shiny!:</>The Shiny! tracker is disabled. All Shiny! dinos are level 210 - use der dino finder via your inventory map tab to help locate them.

<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">Lethal Decay:</> Active, all structure tiers are 21 days & tames 14 days before decay.
<RichColor Color="0.5,0.5,0.5,1">────────────</>
tab4.text2:
Companion Whistle Dump (Workaround)

Step 1: Empty your entire inventory into storage (gear, cosmetics, hotbar — leave only the whistles)

Step 2: Travel to Aberration and spawn at the Matriark Hub spawn point.

Step 3: Pull your implant (R2 on the implant)

Step 4: Respawn again at the Matriark Hub spawn point.

Step 5: Use the Awesome Teleporter or Transmitter to return to previous map.
<RichColor Color="0.5,0.5,0.5,1">────────────</>
